description: This file contains functions and constants related to creating directories safely on Linux systems, including converting file modes to Unix modes and a race-free MkdirAllHandle function that uses file descriptors for secure directory creation.

methods.name: toUnixMode
methods.description: Converts an os.FileMode to a Unix mode uint32, including setuid, setgid, and sticky bits, while validating that no type or unknown bits are set.

methods.name: MkdirAllHandle
methods.description: Creates directories safely on Linux using a provided root file handle, returning a handle to the created directory, with race conditions mitigated by using file descriptors and openat2 when available.
